criteria.name: technical_depth
criteria.description: Spec is detailed enough for implementation; includes concrete schemas, protocols, and algorithms, not just high-level descriptions

criteria.name: judge_system_design
criteria.description: Self-recusal rule clearly specified; judge selection algorithm defined; consensus calculation handles outliers; calibration/bias tracking included

criteria.name: completeness
criteria.description: All 9 required sections present and substantive; routing table schema fully defined; results JSON schema provided

criteria.name: precision_and_clarity
criteria.description: Definitions are precise (e.g., TTFT measured from request send, not response initiation); units specified; no ambiguous statements

criteria.name: open_questions
criteria.description: Open questions are genuine design decisions, not trivially answered; shows systems thinking about edge cases
